name: Suzuki Hayabusa
engine: 1299 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline four, fuel injected
intro: The first-generation Busa. Check the cam chain tensioner, second gear and any drag-bike mods.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 1999 Hayabusas were in recall 00V319 (which replaced 99V270) because the cam chain tensioner spring could break.
A-002.reason: A jumped cam chain can wreck the engine.

add.title: Check the cam chain tensioner
add.instructions: Listen for a rattle at idle. Pull the tensioner and check that it holds the chain. Replace it if in doubt.
add.reason: A weak tensioner lets the cam chain slap or jump teeth.

H: Second gear on first-generation bikes can pop out after hard shifting. Test it under load on the ride.

recalls.what: Cam chain tensioner spring can break and let the chain jump.
